async def act(page):
    # 1) Navigate to the CMS Pages listing (relative to current admin dashboard URL).
    # From /index.php/admin/dashboard/ the CMS pages index should be at ../cms_page/index/
    await page.goto("../cms_page/index/")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # 2) Locate the row that contains the cell "About Us" and get its Edit link's href without clicking.
    # Use a filtered row locator to ensure we target the correct row.
    about_row = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=page.get_by_role("cell", name="About Us"))
    edit_link = about_row.get_by_role("link", name="Edit")

    # Prefer extracting the href and navigating with goto so we can continue interacting after navigation.
    href = await edit_link.get_attribute("href")
    if not href:
        # If no href is present, fall back to clicking the edit link as the last action here.
        await edit_link.click()
        return

    # 3) Navigate to the edit page for the About Us CMS page.
    await page.goto(href)
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # 4) Find the Title textbox (try the common Magento labels) and set it to "Secret".
    title_locator = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Page Title")
    if await title_locator.count() == 0:
        # fallback to a more generic label if necessary
        title_locator = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title")

    await title_locator.fill("Secret")

    # 5) Click the Save button. Try the common label "Save Page" then fallback to "Save".
    save_btn = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save Page")
    if await save_btn.count() == 0:
        save_btn = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")

    await save_btn.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
step_by_step_reasoning:
1) I will navigate from the current dashboard URL to the CMS Pages grid using a relative goto. From /index.php/admin/dashboard/ the CMS pages index typically lives at ../cms_page/index/, so I used page.goto("../cms_page/index/") and waited for networkidle to ensure the page loaded.

2) On the grid I locate the row that contains the cell "About Us" using page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=page.get_by_role("cell", name="About Us")). This ensures I select the exact row for the About Us page.

3) Instead of clicking the Edit link (which would navigate away and make subsequent selectors unreliable), I obtain the link's href attribute via edit_link.get_attribute("href") and then navigate to that URL with page.goto(href). This avoids clicking a navigation link and allows continued scripted interactions on the resulting edit page.

4) On the edit page I locate the title field. Magento commonly labels it "Page Title"; I first try page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Page Title"). If that locator finds nothing, I fall back to page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title"). I then fill the field with "Secret".

5) Finally, I click the Save button. I try the label "Save Page" first, and if not present fall back to "Save". After clicking, I wait for networkidle to allow the save to complete.
